Vertical video shot from her own phone resting on the desk in front of her: the camera itself is the phone, so we see her and the [PRODUCT] from a low front angle. NO phone visible anywhere in the frame, no second camera, no screen facing us. She uses the [PRODUCT] for a moment, then looks up straight into the lens and talks, casual and natural.
